packets_ingested.note: Nonblocking-effect and mutable-effect-pointer findings already exist in earlier deltas; secret-redaction boundary retained as a distinct migration invariant.
Normal PreToolUse non-enforcement, SEBUKKU-only deny and VERIFIED semantic overload corroborate existing effect-contract deltas; no independent replication credit.
Unique useful deltas are Perception Control tier/taint enforcement, bounded ablation evidence, live policy projection semantics and pre-dispatch cancellation on voice barge-in.

dedupe.finding: stern.zulassen ordinary PreToolUse is nonblocking bookkeeping
PostToolUse fallback may create VERIFIED without a pre-admission row and VERIFIED is overloaded downstream
one mutable active_turns.effect_id per session is weaker than immutable per-invocation correlation

semantic_atoms.claim: HeadPolicy mechanically derives compute/inference/memory/persistence permissions from ON, COMPUTE_OFF, OUTPUT_OFF and MEMORY_OFF. evaluate_head resolves semantic dependencies from the central DAG rather than trusting caller-supplied dependency lists. Unknown heads, COMPUTE_OFF heads and heads tainted by unavailable/disabled upstream dependencies return status=NOT_COMPUTED with value=None before compute_fn runs.
semantic_atoms.grid10_delta: Use the same typed distinction in GRID10 and sparse WorldNeed/WorldSlice materialization: NOT_COMPUTED is not false, zero or negative evidence; upstream policy/taint must propagate before cell compute, output and persistence. Keep policy authority deterministic and external to model proposals.
semantic_atoms.failure_boundary: System-wide privacy credit requires source-reachability proof that every protected live head enters through the enforcement point; raw compute function bypasses remain an open audit target.

semantic_atoms.claim: The archived project receipt records a real camera-frame run with object.known.cup set COMPUTE_OFF: the target returned NOT_COMPUTED/value=null while the control person.presence head on the same frame returned OK, and the persisted status table was reported consistent.
semantic_atoms.boundary: This Triggerword-5 run did not independently execute the camera or provider path; the receipt does not establish whole Visual Cortex, Frankenstein-2.0, GRID10, HCU or EntityOS runtime acceptance.

semantic_atoms.claim: Current effect/event persistence applies redaction before bounded journal persistence, and source history records that unfiltered tool input/argv/target previously risked becoming a durable secret sink.
semantic_atoms.grid10_delta: Every typed EffectRequest, decision, execution receipt, result-reentry and recovery record needs one pre-persistence secret fence; prefer exact typed identifiers and digests over raw command/result payloads. Pattern redaction remains defense-in-depth rather than proof against arbitrary secret forms.

semantic_atoms.claim: Realtime function calls are held in a session-local pending queue until response.done. Non-completed responses discard the queue, and barge-in clears pending tool calls before conversation truncation/cancellation, preventing an interrupted model turn from dispatching its still-pending local tool call.
semantic_atoms.grid10_delta: Introduce a typed PENDING_EFFECT state bound to the parent cognition/invocation identity. Cancellation or supersession before EffectGate submission invalidates it deterministically. Once an external effect may have been submitted, transport uncertainty must transition to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN rather than cancellation-success or blind replay.

semantic_atoms.claim: VoiceSessionCapsule is rebuilt from live state/presence/visual/memory/arbitration sources, reads privacy policy from the Perception Control registry, and references the same downstream disallowed-tools policy object rather than owning a copied permission list. It remains RAM-only and noncanonical.
semantic_atoms.grid10_delta: Preserve the capsule as a compiled noncanonical context view, but bind its selected fields to source generation/provenance/freshness in the successor context compiler. A multi-source refresh without a generation contract must not silently become decision authority.

triggerword4_handoff: Treat Perception Control tier/DAG/taint semantics as a concrete donor for GRID cell and WorldSlice controls: COMPUTE_OFF prevents compute; OUTPUT_OFF prevents egress; MEMORY_OFF prevents memory/persistence; NOT_COMPUTED remains first-class UNKNOWN-like evidence rather than zero.
Add a protected-head bypass audit before privacy/system credit: every sensitive live compute edge must either route through the deterministic policy boundary or be explicitly retired/replaced.
Generalize Realtime barge-in into typed pending-effect cancellation only before actual effect submission; after possible submission preserve OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until verified.
Keep VoiceSessionCapsule as a noncanonical projection and add generation/provenance/freshness binding in the explicit context compiler already required by the preceding Triggerword-5 delta.
Carry the donor effect-journal redaction boundary into every new effect/request/result/recovery record; do not persist raw secrets merely for provenance convenience.

contradictions.claim: Perception Control's local enforcement is explicit and has bounded historical ablation evidence, but whole-source reachability proving that every protected live head passes through evaluate_head has not yet been established.

The voice path can safely cancel local pending calls before dispatch, but the same semantics cannot be applied after an external effect may already have been submitted; Frankenstein-2.0 needs an explicit PENDING/CANCELLED versus SUBMITTED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN boundary.

next_exact_gate: Source-reachability audit every protected perception head to evaluate_head and map the PENDING_EFFECT -> deterministic EffectGate submission -> SUBMITTED -> verified outcome/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN state machine into the Triggerword-4 assembly contract; continue preserving feed/inbox migration and donor-closure contradictions.
